About this cruise

Discover crystal-clear lagoons, untouched beaches and the island culture of Lakshadweep, with Cordelia's hospitality on board. Days at sea are for pools, shows and long lunches; your island day is for snorkelling and glass-bottom boat rides.

Itinerary

    Cabin options

    Prices are per person for the selected date and include your cabin, all main meals and onboard entertainment.

    Onboard

    Two pools, a casino, the Marquee theatre with nightly shows, a kids' academy, a spa and six places to eat, from the buffet to à la carte Chopstix.

    What's included

    • Cabin stay for all nights
    • Breakfast, lunch and dinner at the main restaurants
    • Theatre shows and live music
    • Pool, gym and kids' academy
    • Shore excursions
    • Speciality dining, drinks and spa

    FAQs

    Do I need a passport for Lakshadweep?

    No. Indian citizens need a valid government photo ID. Foreign nationals need a passport and a Lakshadweep entry permit.

    When should I arrive at the port?

    Check-in at Mumbai International Cruise Terminal opens four hours before departure and closes two hours before.

    Can I change my sailing date?

    Yes, up to 30 days before departure for a change fee. The fare difference applies if the new date costs more.
